messages:
maria_cs: Quick weekly check-in for BrightBridge post-model swap. Summary:
- Traffic: total calls +14% WoW; new 'v3' model rolled to 25% on Mon.
- Latency: overall p95 rose from 280ms -> 360ms; v3 p95 ~480ms on long-context requests.
- Errors: request error rate 0.6% -> 1.9%, concentrated on >2k token jobs.
- Fallbacks: v3 -> v1 fallbacks peaked at 4.2% during first 6h, now ~1.5% after config tweaks.
- Spend: account infra spend +15% WoW, attributable to longer decoding windows and retries.
Customer sentiment: mentioned slower reports and one truncated export; renewal scheduled next month.

sam_eng: Confirming. Root cause looks like v3 kv cold-miss + regen loops when streaming is disabled. Repro: send ~2200 token prompt with streaming off -> observe 502/timeout in primemodel logs.
Mitigations tried: reduced v3 max_seq to 2048, enabled kv_warmup for canary, and paused large-batch packing for v3. Observing initial improvement.
Plan: monitor 36-48h, then either increase canary or rollback to v1 if fallback >2% sustained.

aj_dev: Data from our side: fallbacks by route: docs-summary 2.3%, chat-concise 1.1%, embeddings 0.0%. Correlation: requests >1.9k tokens AND batch size >=10. I pushed a conservative batch-throttle flag for v3 canary (opt-in) which reduces concurrent large-batch scheduling.

opsbot: Automated alert @channel: 2025-09-02 09:22 UTC - brightbridge_v3_fallback_rate exceeded 3% threshold. 73 fallbacks in 45m. Runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/fallbacks

nora_se: Customer call notes: they reported "intermittent delays for multi-section reports", asked if we can provide a temporary latency SLA for the migration window. They want a mitigation timeline before renewal. I'll request an aid letter offering a monitoring window + rollback guarantee.

leo_research: Model note: v3 uses different KV sharding and benefits from persistent KV shards across requests. Flipping kv_persist for canary reduced simulated p95 by ~35ms but raises GPU memory by ~5%. I can stage kv_persist for 10% traffic tonight if agreed.

maria_cs: Proposed actions:
1) Enable kv_persist on canary for BrightBridge (leo)
2) Keep batch-throttle flag active (aj)
3) Monitor 36h; rollback if fallbacks >2% sustained per sam
4) Nora to offer temporary SLA note + schedule sync with customer (nora)

sam_eng: I'll add an adhoc dashboard: "v3 long-context fallbacks" and a 30m sustained alert at 1.8%. Also added a quick log filter for 502s in primemodel for long requests.

finance_bot: FYI: kv_persist memory increase estimated to add ~7% infra charge for the account (~$1.4k/mo). Logging for billing review.

nora_se: Booked BrightBridge sync: Thu 08:30 PT. Including runbook steps and rollback guarantee in agenda.

maria_cs: Thanks. I'll capture action items in the weekly handoff and ping renewal lead if metrics don't stabilize. TL;DR: new model adoption progressing but watch long-context fallbacks; mitigations planned (kv_warmup/kv_persist + batch throttling); small spend uptick expected. Will post 24h and 36h follow-ups.

sam_eng: Quick update 2h after kv_persist: staged for 10% canary traffic. Preliminary: v3 p95 down ~28ms on canary and fallbacks reduced to ~1.1% in first 90m. Continuing to observe.

maria_cs: Great — please post final 36h snapshot here so I can include in renewal briefing."
